title: Sara C NDE 6327
content: It was my very first delivery at age 31 yrs. Pregnancy was uneventful because I had regular medical checkups with my experienced obstetrician. Both my parents are doctors and therefore, I was medically guided during the entire period of my pregnancy. I had false labor a week prior to my due date for a normal delivery/vaginal delivery. I was sent home and a week later, the contractions were regular between 15 minutes apart. It was October 13, 1973 at approximately 2 PM when I was brought to the delivery room. The attending nurse prepped me. I had the contractions with intense pain and it escalated to almost 17 hours during the night. I could feel the baby wanting to come out but it couldn't. Since my father was a doctor and I was already exhausted, he agreed to an emergency cesarean section. The minute the doctor injected Demerol into my left vein, I blacked out entirely and had no recollection of what had happened. At this moment, it was pitch black and I lost my sense of sight, hearing, speech and feelings. I had no idea how long it was until I saw a bright light. This light grew larger and larger into a tunnel. Inside this large tunnel, there were myriads of bright, multicolored lights on its walls where I flew alongside the tunnel. I also heard angelic songs, which I'd never heard before. I felt I was flying and I felt at peace with myself. I did not see any beings inside the tunnel, only myself. I did not want to go back but then I remembered my baby I had just delivered. With a deep breathe, I willed to return. As I was returning, I went downwards through a deep black well and I felt heaviness on my entire body and legs.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Willed return; described going downwards through a deep black well with heaviness in body and legs.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Emergency cesarean section; blacked out immediately after Demerol injection.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Loss of senses in 'pitch black' before seeing bright light; angelic songs heard in tunnel; return described as going down a 'deep black well' with heaviness.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackness/loss of senses preceded bright light that became a tunnel; no OBE or encounters; returned by will after remembering her baby.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported complete loss of sight, hearing, speech, and feelings in pitch blackness before the light/tunnel; heard 'angelic songs' without seeing beings; return felt like descending a 'deep black well' with heaviness in body and legs.
